supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Visible extension of the ridge beyond the 2D boundary of the outer eye corners

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast between light-intensity muzzle/chin and dark-intensity cheek/periocular regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Prominent vertical thickness with visible central droop of the lower lip

pinna_silhouette.outer_helix_geometry: Rounded apex visible on the viewer-left ear; viewer-right ear is occluded

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct light-pigmented spot or scar on the nasal bridge
other_distinctive_markers: Dense concentration of white/grey hair across the mandibular region forming a beard
